reason: The MS opens Question 3 with the completed reaction scheme (p4 y75-345: the QP's diagram with U CaCl2, V CaO, W Ca(NO3)2, X Ca(OH)2, Y CaCO3, Z CaSO4 filled in) under the bare question number '3', before the '(a)' key; it is the worked answer to QP 3(a) (state the formula of each of U to Y), so it is cut by hand into Q3.a together with the (a) marking rows (p4 y70-433; the scheme boxes start at y73.4, so the cut starts above their top edge). drop_keys removes the automatic Q3 key and its parts, so the remaining Q3 parts are cut by hand at their printed keys: (b) p4 y433-484, (c)(i) p4 y484-607, (c)(ii) p4 y607-639, (d) p4 y639-foot, (e) p5 y69-215. The QP part 3(e) lists two observations (X from Ca(s), X from V) without (i)/(ii) labels, while the MS prints them as '(e) (i)' and '(ii)': both belong to Q3.e, and the printed '(ii)' label (p5 y139) is whited out.
